description: Angular component for configuring SCADA symbol object settings within a widget, including metadata loading, form handling, and change propagation.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolObjectSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing SCADA symbol object settings, including metadata parsing, form management, and change notification.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group, sets up value change subscription, and loads metadata.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, triggers metadata reload if relevant properties change.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's model value and updates the form accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns validation status.

methods.name: loadMetadata
methods.description: Loads and parses SCADA symbol metadata from URL, content, or provided metadata.

methods.name: setupValue
methods.description: Merges default settings with current model and updates the form.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the model value from form and propagates change.
